name: Nippon Express Holdings, Inc.
summary: Nippon Express Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides logistics services in Japan, the Americas, Europe, East Asia, South Asia, and Oceania. The company offers railway forwarding, motor cargo transportation, air freight forwarding, harbor transportation, warehousing, in-factory work, information asset management, and real estate rental services; and heavy haulage and construction.
